text.p: These are the highlights of main stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov said on occasion of Macedonian Army Day celebrations it was Macedonia's long-term goal to take part in the building of Europe's new security architecture. Defence Minister Lazar Kitanovski said on the same occasion "our future lies in the collective systems of security."

- The political organisation for protection of Macedonians in Albania Prespa said Bulgaria should take back its aid sent for 'Bulgarians' in Albania as they do not exist."We are Macedonians, speak the Macedonian language, feel like Macedonians and have our Macedonian schools" they said.
- The Macedonian government will decide in two to three weeks if it will accept the proposal of the French company SISTRA to credit construction of the section of the railroad towards Albania.

- Macedonian Foreign Minister Blagoj Handziski will request UNPREDEP to remain strong. Any change of the mandate of the U.N. peace forces, that is the proposed strengthening of the civilian at the expense of the military component, is unacceptable for Macedonia, said a foreign ministry official.

- Sources close to the Democratic Party of Albanians said the party was preparing to coordinate its political activities with the Party of Democratic Prosperity and a document to this effect would soon to be signed by the two party leaders, Arben Dzaferi and Abdurahman Aliti. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
